MON27-007.owner: P12/security owner with offending source owner
MON27-007.response: Contain the affected path, retain minimal evidence, apply incident/correction process and requalify.

MON27-008.signal: Active journey has neither appropriate due work nor owned actionable exception

MON27-009.signal: Owned exception remains unresolved beyond its recorded review deadline

MON27-010.signal: A projection asserted complete disagrees with authoritative source reconciliation

MON27-011.signal: Confirmed admission outside its reviewed finite intent

MON27-013.signal: Unauthorized scope, hidden-existence signal or private result disclosure

MON27-014.signal: Authoritative active journey lacks required due work or owned actionable exception

MON27-015.signal: Progress claimed terminal disagrees with authoritative item receipts

MON27-016.signal: Unresolved item/owned exception exceeds its recorded recovery or review deadline

MON27-016.owner: Recorded eligible responsible person/queue and existing job operations owner
MON27-016.response: Reconcile source outcome or escalate permitted repair; never treat elapsed time as proof of non-commit.

MON27-017.response: Investigate source/dispatch/qualification, reconcile the same effect; disable new attention admission for broken profile if needed. Preserve source work; no substitute email. Threshold is a planning target, not measured performance.

MON27-018.owner: P27 source owner; current authorized responsibility manager
MON27-018.response: Show source recovery exception immediately, resolve current assignment/eligibility; never broaden access or guess a queue.

MON27-019.signal: Scope leak, unauthorized recipient or duplicate durable active effect
MON27-019.owner: Security/on-call with P27 and P6/P17 owners
MON27-019.response: Stop affected profile, preserve evidence, revoke protected presentation, repair source/contract and requalify before resumption. These remain zero-tolerance release tests.

MON27-020.signal: Permanent projection failure or retry exhaustion
MON27-020.threshold: **One** typed terminal failure under the platform's existing retry policy
MON27-020.response: Surface error and recover/replay original source identity; do not mark review complete or ask staff to repair SQL.

MON27-021.signal: Human review remains unfinished past chosen local date
MON27-021.response: Keep it visible in the existing due/overdue work view; review or deliberately revise it. No new automatic escalation/cadence.

MON27-022.signal: Staff cannot find/act on a review in the admitted surface, or can mistake it for donor contact
MON27-022.threshold: **One** reproducible failure in the supported task flow
MON27-022.response: Fix the flow/copy or suspend that recipient/surface profile; repeat the affected accessibility/usability acceptance before widening rollout.

MON27-023.signal: Incompatible new work or obsolete review attention admitted after accepted closure
MON27-023.owner: P27 source owner with shared-work/P6/P17 owner
MON27-023.response: Disable affected admission path; preserve receipt/evidence; repair source-derived projection and requalify missed writer/fence before re-enabling.

MON27-024.signal: Required surviving obligation loses valid accountability or discoverability
MON27-024.owner: The obligation's source owner, coordinated by P27
MON27-024.response: Restore through authorized owner command; block affected close path until its survival/disposition contract is corrected.

MON27-025.signal: Accepted closure has required projection in a terminal error after the platform's qualified retry policy
MON27-025.threshold: Any terminal error (1); retry policy must be declared before activation
MON27-025.response: Reconcile from durable accepted intent; expose permitted repair status; never rerun the business close. Source-applicability protection applies immediately regardless of retry age.

MON27-026.signal: Closed/no-longer-required work still appears as currently required or changes success/contact totals
MON27-026.response: Correct predicate/projection; invalidate affected cached result; verify matching drill-down/history. Stop affected reporting if meaning is unreliable.

MON27-027.signal: Protected closure/readiness/history data disclosed or restored contrary to current authority/erasure
MON27-027.owner: P12/security owner plus affected data owner
MON27-027.response: Contain affected surface/worker, apply existing incident process, repair the authority/content fence and requalify before return.

MON27-028.signal: Accepted fresh selection references a stage already retired at acceptance, or scoped relationship/history invariant fails
MON27-028.response: Stop affected new writes, preserve evidence, investigate all writers and repair via source; activate wider incident handling if scope unknown.

MON27-029.response: Contain the affected route/cache/export, revoke unsafe access, assess exposure and follow security incident procedure. Never merely monitor continued leakage.

MON27-030.signal: Configuration projection still behind source after a completed reconciliation attempt
MON27-030.response: Mark affected view stale, inspect scoped outbox/projection status, retry/repair without reapplying source change.

MON27-031.signal: One business-effect key produces multiple accepted configuration outcomes
MON27-031.response: Disable affected replay/write path, reconcile provenance and fix effect deduplication before re-enable.

MON27-032.signal: Configuration transaction timeout or deadlock failure
MON27-032.threshold: Three such failures within 15 minutes for the same tenant/preset; proposed operational trigger, not a measured SLO
MON27-032.response: Inspect scoped plans/contention; bound or pause the offending optional operation and correct index/query/batch behavior. Numeric request budgets and database timeouts must be qualified before activation under R17/AC16.

MON27-033.signal: A usability pilot user cannot locate retained retired-stage work, confuses configuration with a journey change, or must use a pointer drag
MON27-033.response: Correct interaction/wording and rerun the affected acceptance task before broader rollout. No unsupported percentage target.

MON27-034.signal: Otherwise valid ordinary stage save requires tenant-added note/acknowledgment/unrelated field
MON27-034.response: Remove the hidden gate from the affected path; rerun AC01/AC03 before reopening that path.

MON27-035.response: Contain affected routes/caches/exports, preserve evidence and invoke security incident handling.

MON27-036.signal: Duplicate accepted stage effect or stale overwrite
MON27-036.response: Stop affected writes, reconcile accepted history and repair protocol before re-enable.

MON27-037.signal: An unconfirmed mutation is still unresolved after one completed authorized reconciliation attempt
MON27-037.response: Keep status unconfirmed, correlate source receipt/read failure and repair; do not ask staff to create a new effect blindly.

MON27-038.signal: Configuration or stage command timeout/deadlock failures
MON27-038.threshold: Three failures in 15 minutes for the same tenant/source slice; proposed operating trigger, not measured SLO
MON27-038.response: Inspect contention/plans, bound affected work and repair; qualified numeric budgets remain an activation prerequisite.

MON27-039.signal: Usability participant cannot identify current/proposed/saved state, complete without drag, or access essential guidance
MON27-039.response: Correct composition/copy, retest that task and block wider release until resolved.

MON27-040.signal: Valid direct skip/backward change blocked by sequence, mandatory note or approval
MON27-040.response: Remove the unintended gate and rerun AC01 on every affected entry point.

MON27-041.signal: Synthetic intermediate visit, duplicate event, stale overwrite or old receipt presented as current
MON27-041.response: Stop affected writes/consumer, preserve evidence, reconcile source history and fix ordering before re-enable.

MON27-042.response: Contain affected routes/caches/exports and invoke security incident response.

MON27-043.signal: Repeated stage counted as new supporter/money or revives consumed work
MON27-043.response: Disable affected derived metric/effect, repair from authoritative facts, replay safely after proof.

MON27-044.signal: Unconfirmed command remains unresolved after one completed reconciliation attempt
MON27-044.response: Keep result unconfirmed, correlate the durable intent and repair the read/recovery path; never request a blind new change.

MON27-045.signal: Same source slice has repeated timeout/deadlock errors
MON27-045.threshold: Three in 15 minutes per tenant/source slice; proposed operating trigger, not a measured SLO
MON27-045.response: Inspect lock/query plans, bound affected traffic and repair; validate against qualified budgets.

MON27-046.signal: Participant cannot distinguish current/proposed/saved, change without drag or understand preserved return history

MON27-047.signal: Valid no-stage admission blocked or silently defaulted
MON27-047.threshold: Any confirmed reproduction on a supported path
MON27-047.response: Fix or disable the affected path while preserving accepted work; add all-path regression evidence.

MON27-048.signal: Eligible unassessed work missing from an ordinary view/declared total

MON27-049.response: Contain affected exposure immediately, preserve minimal incident evidence, require negative authorization proof before reactivation.

MON27-050.signal: Old null intent overwrites a recorded stage or duplicates its effect

MON27-051.signal: Admission/assessment remains unconfirmed after attempted reconciliation
MON27-051.threshold: One completed reconciliation attempt still cannot determine the authoritative result
MON27-051.response: Keep outcome explicitly unresolved, inspect durable intent/result and source revision; do not issue a new effect blindly.

MON27-052.signal: Critical user cannot identify outcome, next action or Set/Change stage
MON27-052.threshold: Any reproducible critical task failure in pilot/support
MON27-052.response: Fix/test the interaction; block expansion of affected flow, preserve a qualified accessible alternative.

MON27-053.signal: Query breaches its approved measured release budget
MON27-053.threshold: Three consecutive measurements within 15 minutes for the same declared workload slice

MON27-054.signal: One create intent yields multiple lists/history effects or visible partial configuration

MON27-055.signal: Creation changes any existing journey/list assignment/stage or triggers outreach
MON27-055.owner: P27 source owner; communication owner for dispatch

MON27-056.signal: Cross-scope metadata, private usage count or journey detail disclosure

MON27-057.signal: Outcome stays unconfirmed after a completed reconciliation attempt

MON27-057.response: Keep the outcome explicit, inspect scoped intent/result/current revision, avoid a fresh effect and recover through the source.

MON27-058.signal: Offered view/report drops eligible work or merges distinct stage meanings
MON27-058.threshold: Any confirmed mismatch for equal authorized scope/coverage
MON27-058.owner: P27 read-model owner; P33 for metrics

MON27-059.signal: Critical confusion about list choice, create effects or saved outcome

MON27-060.signal: Query/payload exceeds its approved measured release budget

MON27-063.signal: Retained usable catalog has zero selectable stages

MON27-064.signal: Accepted configuration lacks required history/result, or same intent has duplicate business effects
MON27-064.response: Contain the affected mutation path, reconcile from authoritative evidence, repair without deleting accepted history and verify retry safety.

MON27-065.response: Contain affected access/cache/export, apply existing incident procedure and verify scope/revocation before reopening.

MON27-068.response: Contain affected cache/API/export access and follow existing incident procedure; verify current-context isolation before reopening.

MON27-070.signal: Accepted result missing required binding/history/receipt or late UI result applied to another context
MON27-070.response: Stop the faulty mutation/presentation path as appropriate, reconcile source evidence and repair without replaying accepted effects.

MON27-071.signal: Staff misunderstand a list as changing giving/access or creating another partnership
MON27-071.threshold: Any validated support report or observed usability failure
MON27-071.response: Reproduce, correct wording/interaction/guidance and retest; investigate erroneous records through the qualified correction path.

MON27-072.signal: Established selected list overwritten by initializer/refetch, or accepted list differs from displayed submitted intent
MON27-072.owner: P27 engineering/on-call with shared UI owner
MON27-072.response: Contain faulty prefilling, preserve qualified manual admission and receipts, identify affected work, fix and regression-test the exact path.

MON27-073.signal: Protected default/target/context disclosed through choice, cache, metadata, export or logs
MON27-073.response: Contain the revealing path and follow existing incident process; verify minimum-safe projection and context isolation before reopening.

MON27-074.signal: Default points to withdrawn/foreign list, withdrawal clears a newer unrelated default, or replay revives a cleared default
MON27-074.response: Stop affected configuration door, preserve durable evidence, repair through the authorized source command and verify concurrent/replay paths.

MON27-075.signal: Optional suggestion outage blocks an independently valid explicit start
MON27-075.response: Restore the independent explicit-choice path, diagnose helper coupling and regression-test failure states.

MON27-076.signal: Staff believe prefill proves suitability or cannot discover/change another permitted choice
MON27-076.threshold: Any validated support report or observed usability failure
MON27-076.response: Reproduce and correct hierarchy/copy/interaction, review resulting record errors through qualified recovery, then retest with users.

MON27-077.signal: Accepted mismatched list/stage, changed journey identity/purpose or duplicate enrollment from a switch
MON27-077.response: Contain the switching writer, preserve evidence/current safe reads, reconcile affected work through authorized source repair and regression-test all affected doors.

MON27-078.signal: Protected old/target/history/context disclosed through UI, errors, cache, export or logs
MON27-078.response: Contain revealing path, use existing incident process and verify minimum projection/context isolation before re-enabling.

MON27-079.signal: Old accepted retry overwrites newer binding, or one intended change duplicates history/required effects
MON27-079.response: Stop defective mutation/replay consumer, reconcile by durable intent and source ordering; fix and retest concurrency/retry.

MON27-080.signal: Accepted change has missing required owner effect or unresolved source-result reconciliation
MON27-080.owner: P27 source owner and shared work/delivery owner as applicable
MON27-080.response: Recover the existing durable effect, never issue a replacement enrollment; diagnose acceptance/consumer seam before resuming affected path.

MON27-081.signal: Staff cannot explain stage consequence or mistake the change for starting over/erasing history
MON27-081.threshold: Any validated support report or observed usability failure
MON27-081.response: Reproduce, correct copy/interaction and resulting records through qualified recovery; retest with representative users.

MON27-082.signal: Accepted binding/history/result inconsistency, invalid scope/list pair, or duplicate accepted occurrence
MON27-082.response: Stop affected writes, preserve receipts/evidence, diagnose and repair through source; requalify before enabling.

MON27-083.signal: Unauthorized disclosure, hidden-as-unassessed classification or cross-tenant result
MON27-083.owner: P12 security owner with P27 owner
MON27-083.response: Contain affected route/projection, follow incident procedure, correct policy and re-run actual-role negative proofs.

MON27-084.signal: Portfolio reconciliation mismatch for the same fully authorized population and source version
MON27-084.owner: P33 reporting owner with P27 source owner
MON27-084.response: Mark affected measure unavailable; fix projection/null semantics and rebuild from source without altering assessments.

MON27-085.signal: A required effect accepted but not reconciled, or an operation result persistently unresolved
MON27-085.threshold: Beyond the existing owning effect/recovery contract's deadline; if none exists, that reached effect cannot be enabled until one is defined
MON27-085.owner: Shared work/effect owner and P27 on-call
MON27-085.response: Reconcile by durable intent, show owned exception, do not replay the business change or create duplicate work.

MON27-086.signal: Confirmed staff confusion causing unintended no-stage save, lost draft, or inability to find Set stage
MON27-086.threshold: Any reproduced user-impacting case in pilot/support
MON27-086.response: Inspect the actual flow, correct wording/state/controls and re-run affected usability/accessibility scenarios; no automatic guessed stage.

MON27-087.threshold: The explicit measured budget agreed for that surface before release
MON27-087.response: Inspect scoped query plans/cohort and regression, repair access path/rendering; no speculative cache or loosening authorization.

MON27-088.signal: Duplicate request/response/effect for one permanent source-purpose identity, or impossible monetary tuple
MON27-088.owner: P27 engineering owner; financial owner for affected links
MON27-088.response: Contain the affected writer/consumer, preserve evidence, reconcile by source identity and repair through qualified correction; investigate before reenabling.

MON27-089.signal: Source-confirmed financial aggregate disagrees with its explicit owner measure after completed reconciliation
MON27-089.threshold: Any nonzero unexplained difference in the same entity/currency/horizon
MON27-089.owner: Finance data owner with P27 reporting owner
MON27-089.response: Mark affected result unavailable/incomplete, stop relying on it, identify duplicate/missing coverage; never alter source money to make the report match.

MON27-090.owner: Tenant development operations owner; shared-work engineering owner for delivery failure
MON27-090.response: Surface the authorized exception, reassign/recover through source controls; do not broadcast protected work or mark it complete.

MON27-091.owner: Security/privacy owner and affected source owner
MON27-091.response: Contain the projection, investigate scope and follow incident/retention procedure; monitoring never substitutes for authorization.

MON27-092.signal: Accepted source mutation missing its required lawful history/result/effect intent
MON27-092.response: Disable affected mutation path, preserve source evidence and repair through an audited owner procedure; treat as atomicity defect.

MON27-093.signal: Accepted decision/action with invalid scope, stale required terms or duplicate terminal effect
MON27-093.owner: P27 engineering on-call + P12/affected action owner
MON27-093.response: Disable affected new decisions/action route, preserve facts, investigate exact receipts/fences and repair through authorized commands before resuming.

MON27-094.signal: Submitted active review with no qualified next reviewer/recovery visibility
MON27-094.owner: Tenant's qualified request/recovery owner; platform support owns delivery defects
MON27-094.response: Show Needs reviewer/source exception immediately; use eligible reassignment or authorized policy correction. Never auto-approve or broadcast.

MON27-095.signal: Committed source review without reconciled required work projection
MON27-095.threshold: Older than 5 minutes, or any terminal projection failure
MON27-095.response: Alert, inspect source/outbox IDs, retry/reconcile safely; show accepted review separately from projection delay. This is a proposed trigger, not a delivery SLA.

MON27-096.signal: Review displayed optional/approved while source status is unknown or denied
MON27-096.response: Stop affected action presentation, repair safe state handling and add regression proof.

MON27-097.signal: Staff pilot mistakes approval for donor agreement, send, or permission to access protected data
MON27-097.response: Revise language/composition and rerun the scenario before pilot expansion; do not solve with more mandatory clicks by default.

MON27-098.threshold: 3 consecutive 5-minute windows, or exhausted retry budget once
MON27-098.response: Inspect per-Tenant plans/lock waits and source reconciliation; throttle affected nonessential projection/import, preserve reads/fact intake and required source authority. Numeric budgets/envelope must be named in the release record before activation.

MON27-099.signal: Unselected inclusion, duplicate current member or stale retry restoring removed/excluded work
MON27-099.response: Stop affected new membership writer/group path, preserve receipts/history, investigate exact ordering, repair through source commands and require regression proof.

MON27-100.signal: Appeal-originated outreach admitted after an earlier applicable exclusion/removal fence
MON27-100.response: Disable affected outward binding, reconcile transport/provider truth, preserve evidence; do not claim recall or delete membership history.

MON27-101.signal: Protected membership/count/reason/result exposed across current scope
MON27-101.response: Contain affected projection/export, investigate disclosure, repair cache/authorization and follow existing incident process.

MON27-102.signal: Accepted membership change lacks required secondary projection reconciliation
MON27-102.threshold: Older than 5 minutes, or any terminal retry failure
MON27-102.response: Surface accepted change versus delayed projection separately; reconcile exact durable intent safely. Five minutes is an operating trigger, not a promised delivery time.

MON27-103.signal: Current membership merge conflict has no permitted recovery route
MON27-103.threshold: Any one detected conflict without a route
MON27-103.owner: P27 source recovery owner + P9 identity owner
MON27-103.response: Withhold affected actionable member only, expose safe resolution, retain history and prevent duplicate workaround.

MON27-104.signal: Pilot participant mistakes inclusion for Asked, or Remove for recall/erasure
MON27-104.response: Revise language/composition and retest before pilot expansion; do not default to more mandatory dialogs.

MON27-105.threshold: 3 consecutive 5-minute windows, or one exhausted retry budget
MON27-105.response: Diagnose measured per-Tenant scans/locks/recovery; bound affected imports/projections without dropping history or bypassing restrictions. Numeric budgets must be named before activation.

MON27-106.signal: Duplicate posting, wrong source linkage or pending item counted as received money

MON27-107.signal: Unresolved physical-gift responsibility silently disappears or recording falsely completes handling

MON27-108.signal: No eligible handler and no owned source recovery route

MON27-108.response: Surface the restricted source exception; repair eligibility/routing without broad broadcast or guessed permission. Keep accepted evidence.

MON27-109.signal: Private handoff/financial facts leak through tasks, logs, exports or cached results

MON27-110.signal: Accepted source change lacks required projection/reconciliation
MON27-110.threshold: Older than 5 minutes, or any terminal retry failure
MON27-110.response: Show accepted source state and delayed projection separately; replay exact durable intent/reconcile financial outcome without reposting. Five minutes is an operating trigger.

MON27-111.signal: Human handling action exceeds its source-owned due/review date

MON27-111.response: Review the actual obstruction/handling, update source next action and existing attention; no automatic donor solicitation or bank-clearance inference.

MON27-112.signal: Pilot user confuses possession, assignment, posting or clearance, or enters a second gift
MON27-112.response: Revise the flow/wording and retest before pilot expansion. No assumed safety from primitive accessibility alone.

MON27-113.threshold: Three consecutive 5-minute windows, or one exhausted recovery budget
MON27-113.response: Diagnose scoped plans/locks/backlog and bound affected ingestion/projections without losing accepted handoffs. Set numeric budgets before activation.

MON27-114.signal: Cross-scope disclosure or changed financial/source truth
MON27-114.response: Disable affected route/effect immediately, contain access, investigate and repair through source; requalify before enabling.

MON27-115.signal: Duplicate Request/task effect or inconsistent canonical identity

MON27-116.threshold: Exceeds the adapter's predeclared freshness budget for two consecutive checks, or any result shown current beyond it
MON27-116.response: Show Updating/unavailable immediately on budget breach; investigate backlog and replay. Do not wait two checks to fix the UI claim.

MON27-117.signal: Missed qualified closure disposition or orphaned required work

MON27-117.response: Stop further closure on the affected path, route existing work for source repair without fabricating completion.

MON27-119.signal: Critical user misunderstanding of response versus actual outcome

MON27-119.response: Block pilot acceptance or affected expansion; correct copy/composition and retest the scenario.

MON27-120.response: Trace source gap, remove duplicate step or repair the authoritative workflow, then verify with affected staff.

MON27-121.signal: Unauthorized body/metadata disclosure, wrong-context save or stale recovered result

MON27-123.signal: Accepted update lacks required local audit/result or duplicates an encounter effect

MON27-125.owner: P9 data/privacy operations owner with P12
